name: SILA – Smart Internal Linking Assistant
author: Mohamed Annajar

sections.description:
SILA – Smart Internal Linking Assistant helps WordPress website owners discover natural internal linking opportunities across posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.

Instead of inserting links automatically, SILA keeps you in complete control. The plugin scans your content, compares title and content relevance, and generates smart internal link suggestions that you can review before making any changes.

Whether you manage a personal blog, a business website, or a WooCommerce store, SILA helps you build a stronger internal linking strategy while keeping your content natural, relevant, and user-friendly.

Why use SILA?

  • Improve your website’s internal linking structure.
  • Discover relevant linking opportunities automatically.
  • Keep full editorial control over every inserted link.
  • Supports WordPress posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.
  • Lightweight and easy to use.

Features

  • Generate smart internal link suggestions.
  • Relevance scoring based on title and content similarity.
  • Separate title score and content score.
  • Review suggestions before inserting links.
  • Approve or reject suggestions.
  • Insert internal links manually.
  • Remove previously inserted links.
  • Internal Link Suggestions metabox inside the editor.
  • Detect existing internal links.
  • Supports WordPress posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.
  • Lightweight and fast.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Link Assistant from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Select a content type and generate suggestions.
  5. Review each suggestion, then approve, reject, insert, or remove links as needed.
sections.faq:
Does SILA insert links automatically?

No. SILA only generates suggestions. Every link must be reviewed and inserted manually.

Does SILA modify my content automatically?

No. SILA never changes your content without your action. Links are only inserted when you click Insert Link.

Which content types are supported?

Posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.

Does SILA support Elementor?

SILA may generate suggestions for Elementor-built pages. However, automatic link insertion into an Elementor-built source page is not currently supported. SILA displays a warning, and the link must be added manually in Elementor.

Can I remove inserted links?

Yes. Any link inserted by SILA can be removed from the Inserted Links section.

Why do I sometimes see “No natural anchor text was found”?

This means SILA found a relevant target page but couldn’t safely identify suitable anchor text inside the source content. You can edit the content manually or choose another suggestion.
